أتلبرل (form IIq)
# أَتَلَبْرَلُ (ʔatalabralu) /ʔa.ta.lab.ra.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# أَتَلَبْرَلَ (ʔatalabrala) /ʔa.ta.lab.ra.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
# أَتَلَبْرَلْ (ʔatalabral) /ʔa.ta.lab.ral/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَبْرَلَ (talabrala)
